personality_one_liner: A high-performance command center built for athletes, favoring dense data, stark contrast, and operational clarity over decorative softness.

spacing.rule: Maintain tight data density but obvious hierarchy. Use 'sm' (8) and 'md' (12) for inner-card grouping, and 'lg' (16) for outer screen margins.

do's: Use heavy glassmorphism for bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use blur on sticky 'Record Workout' CTA backgrounds.
Ensure text on glass is fully readable by adding a subtle translucent tinted base layer underneath.
dont's: Do not use glass for data cards, lists, or form fields.

screens.name: Onboarding / Auth
screens.purpose: High-impact entry with dark moody visuals framing email/password fields.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Form inputs sit in the bottom half. Use Pill CTA buttons in brandPrimary.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A daily command center summarizing workouts, biomarkers, and wearable recovery metrics at a glance.

states.empty: Illustration of tracking rings at 0% with 'Connect Apple Watch' CTA
states.error: Unable to fetch data with a retry tap target

screens.layout: Whoop-style modular tiles. Top section: Three main rings/dials (e.g., Strain, Recovery, Sleep) rendered as dense data-viz. Below: Horizontal scroll of wearable metrics (HRV, Steps) and a vertical feed of today's streak/summary cards.

screens.name: Workouts
screens.purpose: Library and history of sessions, focusing on tracking live performance and exploring new exercises.

states.empty: Iconography indicating no recent workouts, CTA to 'Start First Workout'

screens.layout: Strava-style layout: segmented control (History / Library) pinned top. A list of recent activities below. A sticky, floating 'Record Session' primary CTA at the bottom center over a glass overlay, spanning above the bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Biomarkers
screens.purpose: Deep dive into health analytics, blood markers, and long-term wearable metric trends.
screens.layout: Intense data-viz screen. Line charts and sparklines for metric timelines. Use brandPrimary and warning/error colors to indicate zone thresholds (e.g., green for good HRV, orange for high stress).

screens.name: Community & Coaching
screens.purpose: Social feed of workouts, group sessions, and coach discovery.

states.empty: Message to 'Follow athletes or find a coach'

screens.layout: Tabbed view (Feed / Coaches). Feed uses card-based layout with kudos/comments under workout maps/metrics. Coaches view uses 2-col grid for coach profiles. Heavy use of initial avatars or fetched real-logos for clubs.

onboarding_hero.alt: Runner in crouched starting position on track, ready to sprint

premium_backdrop.alt: Abstract neon green wavy texture on black

coach_placeholder.alt: Focused male athlete in dark gym setting

instructions_to_main_agent: Design constraint: Use '7 Dark-First Utility' personality. STRICTLY adhere to the electric lime (#D4FF00) and deep charcoal (#121212) palette. NO blues, NO purples.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for all display/metric headers to ensure a technical, performance-oriented aesthetic. Use Satoshi for standard UI readability.
Layout constraint: Enforce strict modular card layouts with zero-shadow (shadow_tier 0). Use borders (#2C2C2E) to separate data cards.
Visuals: Implement data-viz (rings, sparklines) for the Whoop-style Home dashboard. Ensure text overlaid on background images (e.g. Onboarding) uses the 3-stop vertical gradient scrim for contrast.
Interactions: On Workouts screen, the 'Record' CTA must be a sticky floating block at the bottom using glassmorphism above the bottom nav.
